item.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

item.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

item.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

item.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

item.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

item.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

item.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.

item.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan, Ram Iyer
item.description: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.

item.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

item.title: Spotify’s AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.

item.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Amazon-owned Ring is pushing into robotics with the launch of a home security drone and a rolling robot designed to patrol and protect businesses.

item.title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions, threatening the accessibility that makes open source communities valuable to developers worldwide.

item.title: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Otter AI just added support for 27 languages and revealed an upcoming feature that can follow along if speakers switch between languages.

item.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.

item.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.
